title: Tiwlafin
lead: Snulfu-d tiwlafin ɣef yiwen n uzegrir Urupan i iqeddcen i udiwenni.
coldStart: Yettali-d umudel — tawlaft tamezwarut deffir n usteɛfu tettawi akud ugar.
seedHint: Seqdec aɛeqqa-nni i wakken ad tsenqedeḍ ibeddilen n usuter s telqey.
negativePromptHint: Yessenfal snat n tikkal akud d wazal n yal asurif.
signInPrompt: Asnulfu n twlafin yella i wid yesɛan amiḍan.
galleryEmpty: Tiwlafin-ik ad d-banent dagi, ad qqiment deg iminig-agi.
errorGeneric: Ur izmir ara ad d-yennulfu uwlaf.
